questions.stem: 為了節省時間，許多上班族會用外送平台訂午餐，再和同事一起吃。
questions.answer: To save time, many office workers order lunch through food delivery platforms and eat it with their colleagues.
accepted_answers: In order to save time, many office workers order lunch from food delivery platforms and then eat it with their colleagues.
Many office workers order lunch on food delivery platforms and eat it together with their coworkers to save time.

patterns: 平行結構（and 連接兩個動詞片語）

questions.stem: 有些父母也靠這些平台解決晚餐，好讓自己能休息並陪伴孩子。
questions.answer: Some parents also rely on these platforms for dinner so that they can relax and spend time with their kids.
accepted_answers: Some parents also depend on these platforms for dinner so that they can get some rest and be with their children.
Some parents also count on these platforms for dinner so that they can rest and keep their children company.

patterns: 平行結構（so that 子句裡的兩個動詞片語）

1.explanation_zh: 「為了節省時間」表目的，句首用 To save time（或 In order to save time），後面加逗號再接主要子句。「上班族」譯為 office workers 或 employees，「外送平台」是 food delivery platforms（也可說 apps），「透過平台訂餐」用 order … through／on／from …。「再和同事一起吃」和前面的「訂午餐」是同一個主詞的兩個動作，用 and 連接成平行結構：order lunch … and eat it with their colleagues，兩個動詞都用現在簡單式。
1.strategy_zh: 同一個主詞做兩個動作時，用 and 連接、動詞形式一致；then 是副詞，不能單獨連接兩個動詞。
hints: 切成四段：為了節省時間／許多上班族／會用外送平台訂午餐／再和同事一起吃
標的詞彙：save（節省）、worker（上班族）、order（訂）、delivery（外送）、platform（平台）、colleague（同事）
句型框架：To VR …, S + V1 … and V2 …

2.explanation_zh: 「靠…解決晚餐」意思是晚餐依賴外送，用 rely on／depend on these platforms for dinner；「好讓…」表目的，用 so that＋主詞＋can＋原形動詞，中文省略的主詞要補成 they（指父母）。so that 子句裡「休息」和「陪伴孩子」用 and 連成平行結構：can relax and spend time with their kids。
evidence: 好讓自己能休息並陪伴孩子
2.strategy_zh: 看到「好讓／以便」先想 so that，再檢查子句有沒有主詞和助動詞 can／could。
hints: 切成四段：有些父母也靠這些平台／解決晚餐／好讓自己能休息／並陪伴孩子
標的詞彙：parent（父母）、rely（依靠）、dinner（晚餐）、relax（休息）、child（孩子）
句型框架：S + rely on … for … so that + S + can + VR1 and VR2

In order to save time, many office workers order lunch from food delivery platforms and then eat it with their colleagues.
Many office workers order lunch on food delivery platforms and eat it together with their coworkers to save time.

common_errors.explanation_zh: 表目的用不定詞 to＋原形動詞；for＋V-ing 多半表示用途，放句首表目的不自然。
不定詞 to 後面接原形動詞。

a lot of office workers
many employees

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「上班族」不要逐字翻，英文說 office workers 或 employees。

accepted: order lunch through food delivery platforms
order lunch from food delivery platforms
order lunch on food delivery platforms
use food delivery platforms to order lunch
order lunch through food delivery apps
order lunch via food delivery platforms

common_errors.wrong: order lunch by food delivery platforms
common_errors.right: order lunch through food delivery platforms
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「透過某個平台」用 through、on、from 或 via；by 後面多接交通工具或方法的動名詞。

common_errors.wrong: use food delivery platform to order lunch
common_errors.right: use food delivery platforms to order lunch
common_errors.explanation_zh: 可數名詞單數前面要有冠詞；這裡泛指各種外送平台，用複數 platforms。

accepted: and eat it with their colleagues
and then eat it with their colleagues
and eat it together with their coworkers
and eat it with their coworkers
and eat together with their colleagues
and then have it with their colleagues

common_errors.wrong: and eating it with their colleagues
common_errors.right: and eat it with their colleagues
common_errors.explanation_zh: and 連接的兩個動作要同形式：order … and eat …，不要一個原形、一個 V-ing。

common_errors.wrong: then eat it with their colleagues
common_errors.right: and then eat it with their colleagues
common_errors.explanation_zh: then 是副詞，不能單獨連接兩個動詞片語，前面要加 and。

traps.literal_error: For saving time, many office workers order lunch through food delivery platforms.
traps.explanation_zh: 「為了…」表目的，用 to＋原形動詞；寫成 for＋V-ing 是常見的字形錯誤。
「上班族」是固定說法，英文用 office workers 或 employees，逐字翻會變成中式英文。

bonus.text: Many office workers save time by ordering lunch through food delivery platforms and eating it with their colleagues.
bonus.explanation_zh: 把「為了節省時間」改寫成主要動詞 save time，再用 by＋兩個平行的動名詞（ordering … and eating …）說明方法；兩個 V-ing 形式一致，是平行結構的進階用法。

traps.literal_error: Some parents also rely on these platforms for dinner so that can rest and accompany kids.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「好讓自己能…」沒有主詞，英文 so that 引導的是子句，要補上主詞 they。

traps.literal_error: Some parents also use these platforms to solve dinner.
traps.explanation_zh: 「解決晚餐」不是解決問題，不能用 solve；說 rely on … for dinner 或 order dinner …。

2.restructuring_zh: 「好讓自己能休息並陪伴孩子」中文省略主詞，英文要寫成完整的 so that 子句（so that they can …），兩個動作再用 and 平行連接；「靠這些平台解決晚餐」也要改寫成 rely on these platforms for dinner，不能逐字翻。

1.translation: To save time, many office workers order lunch through food delivery platforms and then eat it together with their colleagues.
1.explanation_zh: 「為了節省時間」譯成句首不定詞 To save time 表目的；「訂午餐，再和同事一起吃」是同一主詞的兩個動作，用 order … and then eat 對等連接；「上班族」用 office workers；「外送平台」用 food delivery platforms，介系詞用 through。

2.translation: Some parents also rely on these platforms for dinner so that they can rest and spend time with their children.
2.explanation_zh: 「靠……解決晚餐」用 rely on these platforms for dinner，比直譯 solve dinner 自然；「好讓自己能……」用 so that they can 表目的；「休息並陪伴孩子」以 rest and spend time with 對等連接。

issues_zh: （小建議，不影響判定）P1 可接受寫法 So as to save time 放在句首不太自然（so as to 通常不放句首），建議拿掉或只保留句尾用法。

1.translation: To save time, many office workers use food-delivery platforms to order lunch and then eat it together with their colleagues.
1.explanation_zh: 「為了節省時間」用不定詞片語 To save time 放句首；「用外送平台訂午餐」譯成 use ... platforms to order lunch；「再和同事一起吃」用 and then eat it together with 帶出先後順序。

2.translation: Some parents also rely on these platforms to take care of dinner so that they can rest and spend time with their children.
2.explanation_zh: 「靠…解決晚餐」用 rely on ... to take care of dinner；「好讓自己能…」用 so that they can 表目的；「陪伴孩子」譯為 spend time with their children。
